title: Heisenberg Reduction of Parity Observables and Spectator-Induced Contrast Decay in Superconducting Transmon Processors
description: Multi-backend experimental characterization of two-qubit parity oscillations and spectator crosstalk across 156-qubit superconducting transmon architectures (IBM Heron and Eagle r3 backends). Establishes the Heisenberg reduction of the parity channel and quantifies spectator-induced contrast decay.
